feeds.title: Wendy's Quilts and More
feeds.description: I'm Wendy Welsh, a modern hand quilter from New Zealand. I love working with bright colors. I enjoy embroidery as well as quilting and feature both on my blog. I really enjoyed making this quilt and have made more quilts and cushions using the same method. I loved doing all the hand stitching in this quilt.

feeds.title: Karen's Quilting Blog
feeds.description: Karen displays her skill and beautiful artwork including hand-woven quilt, handpiece, and machine piece, and love needle turn applique. Quilting is the main craft that she enjoys although she can handle other needlecrafts and has worked in stain glass. Follow her tutorials, special designs, family stories, and much more here.

feeds.title: Coriander Quilts » Hand Quilting
feeds.description: Check out my blog for hand-quilting articles. I am a quilty mom of two girls and wife to one great husband. In my spare time, I enjoy playing with fabric in the form of quilts and quilt designs.

feeds.title: Blooming Poppies Blog
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Karen! I'm the owner and designer of Blooming Poppies Modern Quilts and currently wearing all the many hats needed to run this small business. My first love of designing with fabric is quilting! I adore the process of creating a functional yet artful item for the home and body. For me, quilts are iconic symbols of warmth, love, and community.

feeds.title: A Left-Handed Quilter
feeds.description: I am A Left-Handed Quilter. A couple of months ago I decided to start a blog to share my love of quilting and maybe some pictures of my projects and an occasional rant. I am not a professional quilter. I quilt for fun. I'm a very visual person. I like someone to show me how they do it - and then I can figure out what will work for me.

feeds.title: Busy Hands Quilts
feeds.description: Busy Hands Quilts posts articles about quilting. She describes herself as a Quilt pattern designer with OQD Obsessive Quilting Disorder. And goes by the statement Just let that girl sew!
